title: Learning Generative Ranking Policies for Whole-Page Optimization
title_zh: 面向整页优化的生成式排序策略学习
abstract_en: A recommendation page is consumed as a whole: the items on it compete for attention and complement one another, so the best page is not simply the individually best items placed side by side. We study whole-page optimization, which selects and orders the items on a page jointly to maximize the score of the page. The number of possible pages grows combinatorially, so good pages must be generated rather than enumerated. Some generative re-ranking methods use the same page-level training signal for every choice in a sampled page. Others imitate target pages built before training, which remain largely fixed as the generator improves. We address both limitations with one local page-level objective, which repeatedly moves the current generator toward pages with higher score. This objective splits exactly into one training target per position, and each target compares candidates at the same partial page by the scores of the complete pages they lead to. Every position therefore learns to choose the item that is better for the whole page, rather than the item that looks best on its own. We call this procedure whole-page policy improvement. On two public datasets, KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS-SeqSlate, which cover multi-objective item selection and constrained ordering, and on an industrial dataset of logged pages, our method outperforms the evaluated generative re-ranking baselines. On a synthetic benchmark with a known optimal page, it also comes closest to the optimum, showing that its improvements come from better whole-page decisions.
abstract_zh: 用户浏览的是整个推荐页面，条目之间既争夺注意力，也能相互补充。因此，单独得分最高的条目拼在一起，不一定构成最好的页面。整页优化（whole-page optimization）旨在联合选择和排列条目，使整页得分最大化。由于候选页面数量随组合规模急剧增长，方法需要生成优质页面，而非逐一枚举。现有生成式重排序方法有的对同一采样页面的所有位置使用相同的整页训练信号，有的则模仿训练前构造、在训练中基本固定的目标页面。本文提出整页策略改进（whole-page policy improvement），用一个局部的整页目标反复更新当前生成策略，使其倾向于生成得分更高的页面。该目标可精确分解为逐位置的训练目标：在相同的页面前缀下，依据不同候选条目所导向的完整页面得分来比较这些条目。这样，每个位置学习的是哪种选择更有利于整页，而不是哪个条目单独得分最高。该方法在 KuaiRand-1K、RL4RS-SeqSlate 和一份工业页面日志数据集上均优于所评估的生成式重排序基线，并在已知最优页面的合成基准上最接近最优解。
key_points_zh: 联合优化条目选择与排序，而不是将单条得分最高的条目直接拼成页面。
整页策略改进（whole-page policy improvement）随当前生成器迭代更新训练目标，既不对各位置照搬同一整页信号，也不依赖预先固定的目标页面。
整页目标可精确分解到各位置：固定已生成的页面前缀，按不同候选条目所导向的完整页面得分进行比较。
在覆盖多目标条目选择和约束排序的 KuaiRand-1K、RL4RS-SeqSlate，以及工业页面日志数据集上均优于所评估的基线；在已知最优解的合成基准上最接近最优。
